rows.note: Happy path: authorized read with typical parameters.
Status filter active: all returned records must have status=active.
Status filter inactive: all returned records must have status=inactive.
Status filter deceased: all returned records must have status=deceased.
No token: must return 401.
write_token lacks read scope: must return 403.
Insufficient scope token: must return 403.
limit at maximum boundary (100): must return 200 with at most 100 records.
limit over maximum (101): must return 400.
limit at minimum boundary (1): must return at most 1 record.
offset beyond total count: data array must be empty.
Unknown orgId: data array must be empty, total must be 0.
Happy path: minimal valid payload, status defaults to active.
Full payload with all optional fields: all fields echoed back correctly.
Status=inactive at creation: response.status must equal inactive.
Status=deceased at creation: response.status must equal deceased.
No token: must return 401.
read_token lacks write scope: must return 403.
Insufficient scope: must return 403.
firstName and lastName at exact maxLength (100): must succeed and echo back correctly.
firstName over maxLength (101): must return 400 or 422.
lastName over maxLength (101): must return 400 or 422.
orgId omitted (required field): must return 400.
Invalid dateOfBirth format: must return 400 or 422.
Happy path: authorized read with existing patient UUID.
No token: must return 401.
write_token lacks read scope: must return 403.
Insufficient scope: must return 403.
Non-existent UUID: must return 404.
Invalid UUID format: must return 400 or 404.
Happy path: valid update with status transition and field update.
Transition inactive to active: response.status must equal active.
Transition active to deceased: response.status must equal deceased.
Disallowed transition deceased to active: must return 422.
No token: must return 401.
read_token lacks write scope: must return 403.
Insufficient scope: must return 403.
Non-existent patientId: must return 404.
firstName at exact maxLength (100): must succeed and echo back correctly.
firstName over maxLength (101): must return 400 or 422.
Happy path: authorized delete of existing patient. Must return 204. Subsequent GET must return 404.
No token: must return 401.
read_token lacks delete scope: must return 403.
write_token lacks delete scope: must return 403.
Insufficient scope: must return 403.
Non-existent patientId: must return 404.
Re-delete already-deleted patient: must return 404.
Invalid UUID format: must return 400 or 404.
full_token has all scopes including delete: must return 204.
